env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd m
logos build -o $WORK/bin/first$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/first$GOEXE
stdout '^order-ok name 1$'
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/badfirst$GOEXE ./bcmd
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
! exists $WORK/bin/badfirst$GOEXE
cd ..

cd p
logos build -o $WORK/bin/perm$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/perm$GOEXE
stdout '^order-ok name 1$'
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/badperm$GOEXE ./bcmd
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
! exists $WORK/bin/badperm$GOEXE
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/order

go 1.27

-- m/c/c.lgo --
package c

type Namer interface {
	const Name() string
}

-- m/u/u.lgo --
package u

import "example.com/order/c"

type Good struct {
	N int
}

var _ c.Namer = &Good{}

func (g *Good) Name() string {
	return "name"
}

func (g *Good) Mutate() {
	g.N++
}

-- m/u/read.lgo --
package u

import "example.com/order/c"

func ReadName(n c.Namer) string {
	return n.Name()
}

-- m/u/bad/bad.lgo --
package bad

import "example.com/order/c"

type Bad struct {
	N int
}

var _ c.Namer = &Bad{}

func (b *Bad) Name() string {
	b.N++
	return "bad"
}

-- m/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/order/u"
)

func main() {
	g := &u.Good{}
	g.Mutate()
	fmt.Println("order-ok", u.ReadName(g), g.N)
}

-- m/bcmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/order/u/bad"
)

var _ = bad.Bad{}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("unused")
}
